[GAME] Hey there, buddy! Welcome to our super chill poker hangout! You're Player 0 and we've got 2 awesome friends around the table for some good old Texas Hold'em fun!
No stress here - just kick back, relax, and let's see who can collect the most chips while having a blast together!
Here's the scoop on our little game night:
- We're gonna play 10 hands (plenty of time to chat and laugh!)
- Everyone starts with 1000 chips (totally fair!)
- Small stuff: 10/20 blinds (just keeps things moving along)

When it's your turn, just let us know what you wanna do with these super easy commands:
  '[Check]'  - just chill and see what happens next
  '[Call]'   - sure, I'll match that bet, why not!
  '[Fold]'   - eh, these cards aren't doing it for me
  '[Bet N]'  - alright, let's get this party started with N chips
  '[Raise N]'- ooh, feeling confident! Adding N more chips to the fun

Invalid actions will result in retries. Use exact bracket format and ensure you have sufficient chips for bets/raises. Check when facing a bet is invalid.
